thread:
maya: bringing up auriga-11b (hf: auriga/11b) — quick sanity check. trying q8_0 quant + rotary + KV cache. seeing hidden-state drift after ~2k tokens, outputs start to diverge from fp16 baseline. anyone seen this pattern before?

jonas: can you paste a minimal repro and the exact context length where divergence starts? sounds like a rotary phase/wrap issue or kv offset bug.

maya: repro below (sanitized):
```bash
# repro (simplified)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\
  -d '{"model":"auriga-11b-q8","input":"[long prompt repeated]","max_new_tokens":2500,"stream":false}'
```
observed: logits align up to ~1.9k tokens, then per-token KL spikes, outputs semantically drift.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: new runtime image rwd/serving:2026-03-18-rc2 rolled to canary pool (3 hosts) for auriga-11b testing. Tracing enabled.

lina: ran quick evals (wikitext-103 and our long-chat bench): q8_0 perplexity +12% vs fp16 when prefix >1024. KV hidden-state L2 diff grows after ~1500 tokens — looks like phase accumulation/scale mismatch, not simple kv index misread. Also saw slight token alignment offsets in a reranking workload.

ash: (typo, meant ash) I've prepared a small runtime patch to adjust rotary phase normalization and avoid the -pi wrap at accumulation boundaries. PR #3421. Need regression runs.

maya: plan proposal:
1) verify rotary-phase patch reduces drift (jonas)
2) re-run quantization with q4_0 snapshot for comparison (lina)
3) add long-context unit tests to runtime (jonas/ash)
4) create temporary routing policy: context>1024 -> route to auriga-11b-fp16 fallback (ash)
assign owners and timeline.

jonas: local smoke test on my devbox: patch from #3421 reduces drift on the 2500-token repro. quick diff:
```diff
- apply_rotary(x, phase)
+ apply_rotary(x, normalize_phase(phase))  # clamp/accumulate change
```
passes local compare against fp16 for 3 runs. pushing instructions to PR.

lina: evals results summary (short):
- q8_0: perplexity +12% on long-chat, hidden-state drift increases after 1500 tokens
- q4_0: perplexity +2-3% vs fp16 (better than q8 here surprisingly), latency lower but some instability on certain prompts
Recommendation: enable routing rule for seq_len>1024 -> fp16 until we ship rotary fix widely. Also update quant calibration set to include long-context samples before next quant sweep.

ash/ash: I'll implement routing policy as a canary config: if request.seq_len > 1024 and model_variant == "auriga-11b-q8" -> route to auriga-11b-fp16. Will ship canary today and monitor p99 latency + error rate.

infra-bot: canary deployed to us-west-2 (3x hosts). tracing + p99 alerts wired.

jonas: added unit test in runtime tests/rotary_long_context_test.py (simple stepwise compare up to 3k tokens). passes locally for patched runtime. I'll open PR for test + small harness.

lina: also will own quant calibration update. I'll add ~10k long-context samples to the calibration corpus and re-run q8/q4 sweep after the rotary patch lands.

maya: owners confirmed: jonas (verify & tests), lina (evals + quant cal), ash (routing + canary ops). PRs to watch: #3421 (rotary fix), #3422 (routing policy), #3423 (rotary_long_context_test). Evals ticket: #1892.

ash/ash: timeline: canary live now, will monitor for 6 hours. If error rate >1% or p99 exceeds budget by 20% -> automatic rollback. Otherwise, promote patch to staged rollout.

evals-bot: summary: auriga-11b-q8 long-context regression detected. Linking eval run: https://evals.redwood.ai/runs/auriga-11b/2008765 (private).

maya: next steps: merge patch + tests once CI green, promote routing policy to default for next 24h while we finish quant re-calibration. Lina to post final eval numbers in this thread when done.

jonas: quick note — watch out for models with rotary variants that use different base frequencies; add a small matrix test across rotary variants in the long-context unit tests.

lina: will post evals and also an AB test proposal for q8 vs fp16 routing on production traffic slices.

maya: thanks all. closing provisional intake — will reopen if new regressions show up.
